paragraphs_zh: 北海岸的海女技藝正快速凋零——根據公共電視新聞報導，目前僅剩少數幾位海女仍在採集石花菜，且技藝傳承已出現斷層（完整報導來源與查證提醒請見〈潮間帶生態與加工〉頁）。
「拾間」希望作為一個持續累積的檔案，而非一次性的展示——內容會隨著訪談與研究進度陸續更新。
paragraphs_en: Sea-women craft on the north coast is fading fast — according to PTS News, only a handful of sea-women are still gathering agar seaweed, and the craft's generational handoff has stalled (full sourcing and a verification note are on the Ecology page).
ShiJian is intended as a living archive rather than a one-off exhibit — content will be updated as interviews and research progress.
